18:34 Remigius.text: Torturers are intended for the daemons, who are always ready to take up lost souls, and torture them in the pangs of eternal punishment.
18:34 Remigius.notes: Newman (1841) translation, as returned by the fetch; not re-checked character by character. Paraphrased, not quoted, in Ch. 8. Remigius of Auxerre (9th c.) is not a Church Father.
